children: R&F Properties (02777) said it recently received a decision from the Guangdong regulator of the China Securities Regulatory Commission to issue warning letters to the group, Chairman and Executive Director Lee Si Lim, and Hu Jie, according to ETNet.

The company said the matter will not have a material adverse impact on its production and operations, financial position or debt-servicing ability. It added that the regulator acted because the group did not disclose overdue interest-bearing debt and major litigation and arbitration matters in a timely manner. R&F Properties said it will review the issues and carry out rectification in line with Shanghai Stock Exchange requirements.

title: R&F Properties Receives Warning Letter From Guangdong Regulator
